implementation_proposal.owner: Use same actual PostGraphSceneState identity already shared by primary/secondary ViewManager and Close, not a separate selection scene.
implementation_proposal.state: Actual selected-item identity set and native int selectionChangeDepth, with independent current-selection coverage qualification. Population coverage and hidden text identities do not imply selection coverage.
implementation_proposal.qualified_empty: Allow only explicit complete empty set state. Preserve depth increment/reset/decrement in source order; selected set remains empty. No notifier counter or callback stand-in.
implementation_proposal.guards: Unavailable selection coverage guards after native depth increment if called as a suspended native-prefix operation. Nonempty selection remains guarded at first item setSelected(false), retaining depth prefix; this makes resumption explicit and avoids replaying an increment. Alternatively expose only a prequalified empty-branch helper and leave caller before native entry when preconditions are unavailable.
implementation_proposal.integration: cc54a0 invokes clearSelection before SfScene cast and top-level histogram/Ptrk queries. Current shared scene-only projection may support qualified SfScene identity but must preserve order; failed cast cannot skip selection effects.
implementation_proposal.tests: Explicit empty state preserves actual text objects and depth; nested depth; independent two-scene identities; unavailable and nonempty coverage refusal; invalidation does not discard selected identities.
